dedupe_keys.name: greater dublin monthly snow and sleet series 1867 2024

description: Zenodo publishes a workbook of regional snow and sleet frequency for the Greater Dublin Area from 1867 through 2024. The article and repository describe counts of days with snow or sleet at monthly, October–May seasonal and calendar-year scales. One XLSX file is listed free under CC BY 4.0. It can provide historical cold-weather exposure for road, rail and electricity-service simulations in Dublin. The counts describe occurrence days, not snow depth, icing duration or conditions on a particular asset. A limitation is that early decades had few reporting stations, and manual observations remained concentrated at staffed sites. Station changes can therefore affect apparent long-term trends. A modeller should inspect the workbook's missing-value codes and station composition before building an event series. The dataset complements data-era5-reanalysis with an unusually long regional observation record, although the reanalysis offers wider variables and spatial coverage. No workbook was downloaded.
